from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class DocumentHeader(BaseModel):
    """Basic metadata about the legal document."""
    title: str = Field(..., description="Full title of the document")
    document_type: str = Field(..., description="Type: Judgment, Ruling, Verdict, Decision")
    court_level: str = Field(default=None, description="Court level: First Instance, Second Instance, Reexamination, etc.")
    court_name: str = Field(default=None, description="Name of the court")

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the case."""
    name: str = Field(..., description="Name of the party")
    role: str = Field(..., description="Role: Plaintiff, Defendant, Applicant, Respondent, etc.")
    party_type: str = Field(default=None, description="Type: Individual, Company, Government, Organization")

class DisputeCharacteristic(BaseModel):
    """Characteristics of the legal dispute found in the text."""
    is_enforcement_proceeding: bool = Field(default=False, description="Whether the case involves civil enforcement/execution proceedings")
    is_administrative_case: bool = Field(default=False, description="Whether the case involves administrative law/government actions")
    is_labor_social_security: bool = Field(default=False, description="Whether the case involves labor, work injury, or social security administration")
    is_property_right: bool = Field(default=False, description="Whether the case involves property rights protection or ownership disputes")
    is_property_registration: bool = Field(default=False, description="Whether the case involves real estate registration/dispute")
    is_administrative_contract: bool = Field(default=False, description="Whether the case involves an administrative agreement/contract")
    is_civil_contract: bool = Field(default=False, description="Whether the case involves a civil contract dispute")
    core_subject: str = Field(default=None, description="Brief description of the core subject matter")

class StatedCause(BaseModel):
    """Explicitly stated cause of action in the document."""
    cause_text: str = Field(..., description="The cause of action or case name as written in the document")

class LegalKeyword(BaseModel):
    """Relevant legal keywords extracted from the text."""
    keyword: str = Field(..., description="Key legal term or phrase found in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated extraction for a single legal document."""
    document_headers: list[DocumentHeader]
    parties: list[Party]
    dispute_characteristics: list[DisputeCharacteristic]
    stated_causes: list[StatedCause]
    legal_keywords: list[LegalKeyword]
